steps.welcome: Welcome to **Petty Market**! This is the table. On the left sits the deck. In the middle is the market, with four cards for sale.
steps.market: Each card has a suit and a value from 1 to 5. Buying a card costs its value in :coin:. The number at the top is both its score and its price.
steps.hand: This is your hand, in your own panel. Cards you buy land here. Above it is your tableau: play cards there to score them.
steps.coins: You start with 3 :coin:, shown on your panel. The player strip at the top shows everyone's score and coins.
steps.market-button: Cards are easier to read up close. Tap **Market** in the bottom bar to open the market gallery.
steps.gallery-tour: This strip is the market gallery, a close-up of the cards for sale. The button in its corner switches between this strip and full screen. Here it is full screen, with the cards you can afford circled.
steps.buy: **Your move.** Buy a card: tap one of the circled cards you can afford.
steps.confirm-draw: Before the game draws a replacement card it asks you to **confirm**, because a draw can't be undone. Tap Confirm.
steps.robin: Now Robin and Sam take their turns. Watch the log: Robin buys a card, and Sam passes to earn 2 :coin:.
steps.play: **Your move again.** Play a card: drag one from your hand onto your tableau. You score its value, and a :coin: card earns a coin too.
steps.end-turn: Nothing random happened this turn, so the game lets you confirm before it ends. Tap Confirm.
steps.history: One more thing: hold **Back** in the bottom bar to rewind and replay what happened. The log line above it describes the current moment.
steps.done:
## That's the game!

- :coin: cards earn a coin when played
- :gem: and :star: cards just score
- Pass when you're broke to earn 2 :coin:

Most points after 3 rounds wins. Robin and Sam will keep playing with you.

hints.market-button: Tap the Market button in the bottom bar.
hints.buy: Tap one of the circled cards. You have 3 coins, so a 1 or a 2 will do.
hints.confirm-draw: Tap the Confirm button in the bottom bar.
hints.play: Press and drag a card from your hand onto the green mat above it.
hints.end-turn: Tap the Confirm button to end your turn.
